Record Key.description: The record key, <prefix>_<slug>. The skills find a record by it.

Superseded by.description: The key of the record that replaced this one.

Source note.description: Who or what said it, with a date.

Saved.description: The date of the last change.

Authorization.description: What allowed the save, for example "Approved by Mike on 2026-09-29".

Work item IDs.description: The IDs of the work items this record relates to, for example "IML-3, IML-5", and their links when they are not in this workspace.
